question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Answer
solution:
**The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Reply.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:
 
 
• Answer - a reply to a question. (जवाब)
 
• Reply - to respond to something that has been said or written. (जवाब देना)
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​
 
 
• Recall - to remember something from the past. (याद करना)
 
• Remember - to bring back to mind; to not forget. (याद रखना)
 
• Query - a question, especially one addressed to an official or organization. (सवाल, प्रश्न)
 
 
 
• Clearly, the word 'Reply' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Answer.'
 
• **Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 2.**

33:T765,
योग्य उत्तर पर्याय 2), म्हणजे 'Reply' आहे.</s
